title: Create a manual workflow reference solution

answer.approach: A complete response for create a manual workflow should include: workflow_dispatch:, inputs:, run:.
answer.example:
name: Manual preview
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      target:
        description: "Preview target"
        type: choice
        options: [staging, demo]
        required: true
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  preview:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Show selected target
        env:
          TARGET: ${{ inputs.target }}
        run: echo "Preview target is $TARGET"
answer.verification: A manually started run validates the choice input and prints only the selected non-destructive preview target.
